attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his Substack post, stated in his own voice and not quoting anyone else.

semantics.note: 'More confident than ever' plus 'won't' is a high-confidence, unqualified forecast, so it is scored. 'This year' in a 2024-06-21 post means by 2024-12-31. The normalised proposition matches the statement.

contract.note: Reading 'land' as a public release of a model OpenAI calls GPT-5 is the natural reading. No plausible alternative reading changes the result, since no GPT-5 appeared in 2024.

evidence.note: OpenAI's launch page, dated 2025-08-07, is the primary record of the release event. 'Introducing' marks this as the first release, which places GPT-5 after the 2024 deadline. It is a company disclosure, but it is direct evidence of the launch date.

output.rationale: The forecast's deadline of 2024-12-31 has passed. OpenAI's own announcement introduces GPT-5 on 2025-08-07, so no model called GPT-5 was released in 2024. The packet lists no counterevidence. The forecast came true.
